title: David Choe on The Steebee Weebee Show — Episode 30, Part 2
summary: Part 2 restates Choe's need for candor plus edit control, then maps Steve Lee's prayer, recovery, sex, sleep, gaming, Patreon and production routines. Explicit family speculation, private-neighbor allegations, security footage, a weapon disclosure and racialized relationship claims remain in raw context but are excluded from searchable biography. The ending documents Steve's long relationship and growth without exposing private partners or converting anecdotes into diagnoses.

quality.assessment: Complete chronological read. All explicit, religious, recovery, financial, family, security, weapon and racialized ideas remain; 166 separate decisions repair caption damage and bound private or unsupported claims. No publisher speaker labels exist.

speaker_policy: Source-level public participants include David Choe and Steve Lee, with crew voices. Auto captions do not authenticate individual turns; publish zero named turns pending held-out validation.
